description: How many bags of self-leveling underlayment or floor resurfacer to buy, from your floor area and the thinnest and thickest pour depth, using the bag's yield in cubic feet. Formula: Average depth = (thinnest + thickest) ÷ 2. Volume = area × average depth ÷ 12. Bags = volume × (1 + allowance) ÷ yield per bag. Coverage at 1/4 in = yield ÷ (0.25 ÷ 12).

bag_yield_cuft.description: Yield per bag (from the bag or data sheet) (cu ft); default 0.45
